description: Compact Remilio proportions with springy readable limbs, broad facial motion, and tightly registered feet.

motionGrammar.idle: Readable breath and blink with a tiny compact-body squash.
motionGrammar.directionalRun: Springy alternating gait with clear contact and flight phases.
motionGrammar.wave: Friendly shoulder-and-hand wave with stable feet.
motionGrammar.failed: Comic whole-posture slump without detached effects.
motionGrammar.waiting: Patient foot tap or expectant lean.
motionGrammar.working: Busy hands and concentrated face, never a running gait.
motionGrammar.review: Forward inspect and compact approving nod.
motionGrammar.look: Large eyes lead, followed by head and upper torso; preserve facial proportions.
